description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which is a core component in a logging framework within an Android project. It specifies a method for logging messages, supporting chained logging nodes for flexible output handling.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging system node that can output log messages and be linked in a chain for extended logging capabilities.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to this LogNode.
